scope: ATRIA 5.0 core, RESP-01 V2 experimental validation
immutableRule: Create a new versioned snapshot on changes; never rewrite prior snapshots

clinical.freedom: Allow any medically inappropriate action supported technically by the validated formulary/clinical controls; never veto using hidden true case ID
clinical.technicalLimits: Reject impossible routes, unparseable dose dimensions and absent required physical access; these are not medical-indication gates
clinical.physiologyOwner: existing native clinical physiology and nursing-time engine
effects: only confirmed receipts and actual elapsed native time affect physiology
pending orders, random candidates alone and chat declarations have no effect
random complication onset is eligible by measured state plus seeded candidate
recover only after delivered effective rescue and elapsed recovery
clinical.diagnosis: physician declares their own hypothesis, not prefilled by Dr Vega
clinical.historyAndExam: free interview and directed physical exam with authored patient personalities; actual receipts required
clinical.nursing: single physical nursing executor and authoritative queue, with durable completion
clinical.hints: Dr Vega provides exactly one actionable prioritized suggestion; -5% per distinct displayed usable hint, cumulative to zero; repeats/waits/stale/impossible are free; same authority and real control in every mode; cooperative financial penalty is shared by all active members, regardless of requesting actor
clinical.clinicalScore: Only authored hidden case requirements contribute positive quality points upon actual safe closure. No points for extra unnecessary acts; confirmed wrong care, delays, iatrogenia, overtesting harm lower quality. Minimum safety gates are distinct from quality. Single native scoring/XP owner.
clinical.unsafeElectiveDestination: Doctor is free to try unsafe alta/observacion or old partial command in V2; Dr Vega rebukes, verified -15 XP, NO CLOSURE, patient and all observations preserved and claimable by same or other authorized doctor; active monitoring is not closing.
clinical.activeObservation: observación clínica is not formal closure and never triggers inappropriate-disposition penalty
clinical.legacyPartialClosure: V1 historical partial-close may award reduced score for incomplete but allowed care. V2 incomplete elective alta/observation cannot bypass native safety or Dr Vega. Preserve V1; no other scenario-specific switch.
clinical.transfer: real receiver acceptance and safe handoff required; receiver should use publicly declared diagnosis and communicated evidence, never true hidden case ID
clinical.continuity: persist patient UID, measured vitals, treatments, orders, complications, chat, native clock, medical actions and unique XP receipts across reconnect
clinical.physiologicalParameterization: case files provide only declarative trajectory, eligibility, pharmacology response, complication probability and rescue rules; no case-specific executor fork
clinical.patientVariability: Reproducible seeded names, age, 7 personalities, histories, allergies, dialogue and plausible complication candidates; no reveal of unpublished facts or random future.
clinical.studiesExam: Patient first-person natural history; physical exams per region/technique shown in exam panel only; studies with real delays, synonyms, patient-bound results and no hidden spoilers.
clinical.receiver: Receiving service accepts/refuses only clinically communicated presumed diagnosis, measured vitals, exams, studies, stabilisation and capacity; must not read true hidden case ID; accepted consultation is not surgery/procedure done.

coop.care: shared clinical history and physical nursing
coop.reward: SHARED team career and XP among active participants: gains, errors, causally attributable death, and -5% Dr Vega new displayed hint requested by ANY teammate. No credit for inactive absence; reconcile on rejoin. This supersedes per-actor hint deductions in 1.0.0/1.0.1.
coop.hints: Distinct valid hint shown to any active doctor penalizes entire active team once; repeated/wait/stale hints free; per-player display history allowed but not independent personal XP debt.
coop.ownership: No exclusive claim. Both/all active physicians can perform real actions on any patient; independent repeated medication orders produce separate exposures; network duplicate IDs are idempotent.

competitive.care: exclusive patient owner, with private clinical chart outside permitted access
competitive.patientClaim: one physician at a time; release upon unsafe elective disposition
competitive.reward: Individual XP, errors, causally attributable patient-death penalty and hints. Only verified owner earns the case, rival penalty never crosses account.
competitive.ownership: Exclusive bedside claim, one clinical owner at a time; after unsafe formal alta/observation patient released, same patient preserved and claimable by same physician or another authorized competitor.

sharedShift.continuation: persisted decision after all active participants agree; otherwise save or exit
sharedShift.afterEnd: Guardia finalizada: Continuar otra guardia (24 minutes) OR Guardar y salir; preserve XP, history, unfinished cases, pending procedures, deaths/penalties, multiplayer and exactly-once rewards.
sharedShift.acuity: Reception green/amber/red according to actually evolved native physiology, never queue-wait fabricated vitals.

extraRules.controls: Compact four-row ATRIA mobile keyboard, explicit clinical autocomplete (never auto-send or silently change doses/drugs), bedside checklist, exam panels, reachable controls and Android landscape/portrait.
extraRules.communication: Private Team messages separated from clinical Activity, true first-person patient and nurse conversation, proximity and UID isolation.
extraRules.music: ~2.5 second crossfade, ~250ms silence fade, do not change an unchanged track, classic guard default, new lobby music, persist user options, keep effects/alerts.
extraRules.interface: 2D map, original sprites/camera, reception, live monitor synchronized to native heart rate, compact score/level, visible XP animations Tibia style.
extraRules.account: Persistent secure doctors, unique normalized display names, preserve pre-existing accounts, authenticated same-account explicit handoff, no stealing sessions.
extraRules.deployment: Production/main/4.8.7 unchanged. Modular GitHub branch only, preview of approved SHA with rollback, future portable to Vercel in requested 21-day horizon conditional on real tests.
extraRules.testMandate: At least 10 meaningful bot profiles x 55 historical cases, 4-mode V2 integration, equal-seed V1 vs V2, meds/wrong doses/delay/rescue/death, long guard, concurrency 2/3/4, Android physical devices and real Vercel/Supabase persistence
